description: Hộp duyệt, the signed-in person's review inbox in Drint: the work their space handed on to Drint 3D Studio (scenes, renders) or Drint AI (design edits, pictures, films), and the results that came back and wait to be accepted into the project. Each job has its project, status and, once done, its result pictures (links valid ten minutes). Accepting happens in Drint: each job has a link that opens its project with Hộp duyệt up. Optional: project (an id from list_my_projects), waiting_only.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

project.description: Only the jobs of this project (id from list_my_projects). Optional.

waiting_only.description: Only the jobs whose results wait to be accepted. Default false.

name: review_inbox
title: My Drint review inbox
